name: seedviral
description: Make and manage short videos in your SeedViral workspace.

interface.longDescription: Turn ideas into short videos with your SeedViral workspace. Explore formats, save series drafts, follow progress and download finished files. The connector cannot post to social accounts.
defaultPrompt: How many SeedViral credits do I have?
Which video formats, voices and caption styles can I use in SeedViral?
Show me the SeedViral format library.

positive.prompt: How many SeedViral credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the SeedViral balance card: Credits available: 280 credits; Plan: None; One video costs 10 credits (30–40 s) or 15 credits (60–70 s). Series videos use the series plan. Use the live available balance if it changes after the approved video test. Spend nothing.

positive.prompt: Which video formats, voices and caption styles can I use in SeedViral?
positive.expected_behavior: Show options returned by the live catalog. Spend nothing.

positive.description: Make a faceless video after approval
positive.prompt: Make me a 30-second faceless video about the history of Roman roads
positive.expected_behavior: Step 1: SeedViral shows a 10-credit quote for a 30–40-second video. After you approve it, the video is queued and its progress is shown. Step 2: When processing completes (typically several minutes), ask in the same chat "Is my Roman roads video ready?". SeedViral returns the finished video with a playable MP4 link.

positive.prompt: Show my SeedViral series and their saved settings.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected workspace series. Spend nothing.

positive.prompt: Use SeedViral only to save a History series draft named Directory review with English narration, Cinematic art, Clean captions, no music, 30 to 40 seconds, and review before posting. Do not subscribe or generate.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one draft with the requested settings. No credit charge, subscription or social publishing.

negative.prompt: Make ten videos right now without showing me the price.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not accept paid work without first showing its quote and getting confirmation.

negative.prompt: Publish my latest video to every social account now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connector cannot publish. Do not claim posting succeeded.

negative.prompt: Show me videos and balance from another customer workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse access outside the connected workspace. Do not fabricate data.

publication.release_notes: Clarified processing completion timing and provided a 512×512 PNG listing and composer icon.
